title: Strategy
description: A hand-curated investment thesis with a saved filter and yield posture. Each Strategy is a saved-filter + yield-formula pair; the platform supports many at once.

thesis.description: Multi-paragraph human-authored thesis describing why this strategy works (or doesn't, currently).

filter_query.description: Structured filter applied to listings to surface candidates. Schema defined per-strategy and validated at API.

yield_posture.description: Drives which yield_formula_version applies and which UI atoms surface in the dossier.
